svg.aria-label: The real g letter card, plus the real position 1 card, gives the 128 numbers that the g in position 1 takes into block 1. The g card begins −0.049, 0.032, 0.014, 0.030; the position 1 card begins with its own numbers; and each number of the result is the sum of the two numbers above it.
svg.text: Letter card + position card = working card 1, ready for block 1
All 128 real numbers of each, from my trained model. Blue is above 0, orange below; the darker, the bigger.
Each number on the right is the sum of the two in the same place on the left: −0.049 + 0.043 = −0.006.
The g card is the same wherever g appears. The position card is the same for whatever letter lands in position 1.
The sum, working card 1, is what block 1 receives. Only it changes from here on.
